title: uml4net-sage index.json files
description: The flat, array-shaped index files a generated knowledge base contains: metamodel/index.json, standard-profile/index.json, and (once spec text is extracted) spec/index.json - the last of these shared by both knowledge/<version>/spec/ (the OMG UML specification) and the top-level sibling knowledge/xmi/<version>/spec/ (the companion OMG XMI specification), disambiguated by each row's own "document" field. Each is an array of rows rather than a keyed map so it also qualifies as a valid Frictionless tabular-data-resource (see datapackage.schema.json).

metamodelIndex.description: knowledge/<version>/metamodel/index.json - one row per class, enumeration, primitive type, or association.

standardProfileIndex.description: knowledge/<version>/standard-profile/index.json - one row per Standard Profile stereotype.

profile.description: Qualified name of the profile that owns the stereotype (IStereotype.Profile).

baseMetaclasses.description: Simple names of the metaclasses this stereotype itself extends (not those of its specializations), sorted; whether each extension is required is on the stereotype's own page.

specIndex.description: <spec-tree>/index.json - one row per extracted specification clause, where <spec-tree> is either knowledge/<version>/spec/ (UML) or knowledge/xmi/<version>/spec/ (the companion XMI specification). Present only once the corresponding PDF has been fetched and successfully extracted.

clause.description: Clause number: dotted-decimal for the numbered clauses (e.g. "9.3.2"), the annex letter for an annex itself (e.g. "B" for Annex B), or letter-prefixed for an annex subclause (e.g. "B.5.2").

document.description: Which OMG document these clauses were extracted from, e.g. "UML" or "XMI" - disambiguates rows from the two structurally-identical spec index files.

pages.description: A single page number or an "N-M" range.

file.description: Relative to the spec tree, e.g. "clauses/9.3.2-classifier.md".
